basis: the feedback path of this platform is the MuJoCo closed loop: the stop window's velocities are MuJoCo's own joint velocity state (mjData.qvel, read by MujocoStopFlight.joint_velocity_vector through the joint's jnt_dofadr), so there is no encoder, no counter and no count-to-angle conversion anywhere between the plant and the stop envelope. The quantisation term of stop_velocity_rad_s is therefore identically zero on this platform, and the envelope is governed by the measured stationary noise term plus the controller's stopped tolerance. A missing resolution would not justify this zero: it is declared here, with this statement, and the producer refuses a document whose quantisation_rad is absent or null instead of defaulting it.
